messages:
Priya (Support): Hey team, Acme Ops reporting intermittent 403s when uploading private debug bundle via the collector. They sent request IDs and a curl repro.
Acme Ops: Upload fails around 30s, S3 returns 403 AccessDenied. Request ID: rq-9c8b2f4a. Using collector v1.5.2 on-prem behind NAT.
Marcus (Eng): @Priya can you paste the exact curl command they used?
Acme Ops: sure — curl -v -X PUT "https://s3.company-region.example/bundles/abc123" -H "x-amz-meta-manifest: ..." --upload-file bundle.tar.gz
Anna S. (Solutions): Do we have a signed-manifest flow here? If the collector presigns and then rotates credentials, presign might expire. @Asha any recent IAM key rotations for that batch?
Asha (DevOps): No rotation scheduled. I checked our logs, the presign service returned 200 for manifest with id abc123 at 2026-03-10T14:02:13Z. But collector logs show TLS handshake resets then 403.
collector-bot: debug-bundle-generator: created bundle abc123, size=42MB, checksum=sha256:aa11...ee22, manifest.signed=true
Priya (Support): Ok can we get the collector debug bundle from customer? Ask for the collector log snippet and the redaction manifest. Also request a curl --trace-ascii output.
Acme Ops: attaching snippets: "ERROR UploadHandler - 403 AccessDenied (request rq-9c8b2f4a)" and their environment: COLLECTOR_UPLOAD=S3, REDACT=true, REDACT_PROFILE=default
Marcus (Eng): Quick repro steps for us: 1) Get signed presign from the customer's endpoint. 2) Attempt PUT with curl, include the same headers the collector sets. 3) If 403, capture wire trace (`curl --trace-ascii trace.txt -v ...`) and bundle logs.
Anna S. (Solutions): Also ask them to run collector with DEBUG=1 and to run `./collector --collect --redact-manifest` to generate the debug bundle locally then try an alternate upload (scp to a host we give) so we can validate redaction before S3 upload.
Priya (Support): I'm going to ask for: full collector logs (last 500 lines), the signed manifest, the curl command + --trace, the debug bundle tarball (or scp fallback), and the bundle checksum. Also include timestamps and the request ID. Sending a message to Acme now.
Acme Ops: Sent bundle to our temp sftp host, link: sftp://sftp.redwood-temp.example/acme/abc123.tar.gz — user and one-time creds provided via DM.
Marcus (Eng): Good. Once we grab it we'll run local upload using our presign service to reproduce. If redaction mismatch, look at redact rules; often unicode samplers cause omitted fields that change checksum and trigger manifest rejection.
Asha (DevOps): One more note: ensure collector uses system clock synced (chrony/ntp). We had a previous case where clockskew invalidated signed headers and resulted in 403s.
Priya (Support): Thanks all — I'm opening an internal ticket and will attach the bundle link + request IDs. If we can reproduce with their curl trace we can escalate to eng-runtime. I'll post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
